parsed.post: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 yielded a significant drop in val_bpb (1.0733 -> 1.0543). Larger capacity seems to be a strong driver. Now I will try to reduce the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute window, potentially accelerating convergence.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH to 6 and reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimization steps per 5-minute budget.
